Good news — based on your posted Platinum Rewards Card transactions, you met the monthly spending threshold in each of the 12 monthly windows for the cardmember year that runs 11/10/2024–11/09/2025.

What I checked and how:
- I used your Platinum Rewards Card transaction history and the card’s rebate rule from our knowledge base (the rebate requires meeting a $7,500.00 monthly posted-purchases threshold in every monthly window of the cardmember year).
- Monthly windows are measured from your account open anniversary (your windows are 11/10–12/09, 12/10–01/09, …, 10/10–11/09).
- I summed posted purchases (excluding refunds, fees, cash advances, balance transfers, and disputed items) that posted in each window. Every one of the 12 windows had posted purchases above $7,500.

Important next steps and notes:
- Eligibility is officially assessed after the close of your 12th monthly window; if you qualified, the rebate is applied as a statement credit after the annual fee for that cardmember year is billed.
- If your first cardmember year’s annual fee was waived by a promotion, the rebate would not apply to that year — eligibility would start with the first fee-billed year after the waiver. (If you aren’t sure whether your first annual fee was waived, I can check that for you.)
- Returns or credits that post later could affect a month’s total; the system only counts what is posted within each monthly window.

Would you like me to:
- Check whether your first-year annual fee was waived or confirm whether the rebate has already posted or is scheduled?
